nodes.description: Controller public dao - DAO controller reference resolved from nameService
address public avatar - DAO avatar that is the sole admin authority
INameService public nameService - resolves trusted system addresses (CONTROLLER, GOODDOLLAR, GDAO_*)
mapping(address => uint256[]) public balances - packed checkpoint history of reputation balances
uint256[] public totalSupplyHistory - packed checkpoint history of total supply
mapping(address => address) public delegates - current delegate of each account
mapping(address => uint256[]) public activeVotes - delegated vote checkpoint history
mapping(address => address) public reputationRecipients - redirect target for earned reputation
mapping(address => uint256) public nonces - signature replay protection counter
mapping(bytes32 => BlockchainState[]) public blockchainStates - per chain state hash history
mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => uint256)) public stateHashBalances - balances proven against a state hash
bytes32[] public activeBlockchains - list of registered blockchain id hashes
mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) private _roles - AccessControlUpgradeable role membership
_onlyAvatar() internal view - requires dao.avatar() == msg.sender, the master access gate
updateAvatar() public - resolves controller from nameService and refreshes dao/avatar, unauthenticated
Reputation.mint(address,uint256) public - mints reputation after _canMint check
Reputation.burn(address,uint256) public - burns own reputation or requires minter role
Reputation._mint(address,uint256) internal virtual - updates supply and balance checkpoints
Reputation._burn(address,uint256) internal virtual - caps and subtracts burned reputation
GReputation._mint override - redirects to reputationRecipients and updates delegate votes
GReputation._burn override - removes delegate votes after burning
GReputation._canMint override - allows GDAO contracts or MINTER_ROLE holders
proveBalanceOfAtBlockchain(...) public - verifies merkle proof and writes/proves user balance, may mint for ROOT_STATE
restoreState(...) public - one-shot bulk state restore that writes balances and mints reputation
delegateBySig(...) public - EIP-712 signature based delegation with nonce and expiry checks
delegateTo(address) public - delegates votes of msg.sender
_delegateTo(address,address) internal - moves delegated vote checkpoints between delegates
setReputationRecipient(address) public - sets reputationRecipients for msg.sender
setBlockchainStateHash(...) public - avatar gated registration of a chain state hash
_authorizeUpgrade(address) override - UUPS upgrade authorization, delegates to _onlyAvatar
upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) public payable - proxy upgrade plus delegatecall payload
_updateDelegateVotes(address,address,uint256,uint256) internal - writes activeVotes checkpoint and emits event
getValueAt(uint256[],uint256) internal view - binary search over packed checkpoints
updateValueAtNow(uint256[],uint256) internal - packs block.number and value into checkpoint storage
checkProofOrdered(...) public pure - non sorted merkle tree proof verification
grantRole(bytes32,address) public - role granting restricted by onlyRole(adminRole)
renounceRole(bytes32,address) public - requires account == _msgSender()
_setupRole(bytes32,address) internal - grants a role without any authorization check
GReputation.initialize(...) external initializer - sets up DAO, roles and optional initial state hash
msg.sender - external caller used for authorization, delegation and recipient binding
block.timestamp - used as the signature expiry reference in delegateBySig
ecrecover(digest,_v,_r,_s) - raw signature recovery used to derive the signatory
target.delegatecall(data) in ERC1967Upgrade - executes arbitrary code in proxy storage context
nonces[signatory]++ - unchecked-per-call monotonic increment used for replay protection
stateHashBalances[stateHash][_user] = _balance - attacker supplied balance is persisted after proof
checkpoints.push(uint256(uint128(block.number)) | (_value << 128)) - packed block/value storage write
_user parameter of Reputation.mint
_amount parameter of Reputation.mint
_user parameter of proveBalanceOfAtBlockchain
_balance parameter of proveBalanceOfAtBlockchain
_proof merkle path parameter of proveBalanceOfAtBlockchain
_nodeIndex parameter of proveBalanceOfAtBlockchain
_delegate parameter of delegateBySig
_nonce parameter of delegateBySig
_expiry parameter of delegateBySig
_v signature component of delegateBySig
_r signature component of delegateBySig
_s signature component of delegateBySig
_accounts array parameter of restoreState
_stateValue array parameter of restoreState
_mintValue array parameter of restoreState
_fuseStateHash parameter of restoreState
_target parameter of setReputationRecipient
_id blockchain name parameter of setBlockchainStateHash
_hash state hash parameter of setBlockchainStateHash
_totalSupply parameter of setBlockchainStateHash
newImplementation parameter of upgradeToAndCall
data payload parameter of upgradeToAndCall
signatory recovered from ecrecover inside delegateBySig
digest EIP-712 hash built inside delegateBySig
stateHash local read from blockchainStates inside proveBalanceOfAtBlockchain
leafHash keccak256(abi.encode(_user,_balance)) local
isProofValid boolean returned by checkProofOrdered
computedHash accumulator inside checkProofOrdered
curDelegator previous delegate inside _delegateTo
coreBalance amount of votes moved inside _delegateTo
curTotalSupply local inside Reputation._mint
previousBalanceTo local inside Reputation._mint
amountBurned capped local inside Reputation._burn

setBlockchainStateHash pushes a new BlockchainState into blockchainStates

getValueAt binary searches the packed balance checkpoints
getValueAt binary searches the packed total supply checkpoints
msg.sender must equal dao.avatar() to pass the _onlyAvatar guard
